test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Sai can do a piece of work alone in 50 days. Ria is 25% more efficient than Sai. What is the number of days that Ria will take to do the same piece of work alone?
solution:
Given:

Sai can do a piece of work alone in 50 days. Ria is 25% more efficient than Sai.

Concept used:

1. Efficiency (work done per day) of workers is inversely proportional to the time taken by workers to complete a particular task.

2. Incremented/Reduced value = Initial value (1 ± change%)

Calculation:

Time taken by Ria to complete the work = 50 ÷ (1 + 25%) = 40 days

∴ Ria will take 40 days to do the same piece of work alone.
